title: Take-off quantity policy (ContechCost house policy, non-canonical)
status: PROPOSED, awaiting owner approval. CMM Edition 1.0 states no rounding rule. The principle (source precision kept, rounding only at billing) is agreed; the default rule below (whole units, half up, minimum 1 for any positive quantity) is not yet approved.

precision.source_measurements: Keep the precision the source supplied. Do not round when staging.
precision.billed_quantities: Rounded for BOQ presentation or billing only, by the rule below.
